sampling: prose paragraphs (front matter, headings, tables and fenced code excluded; list blocks count as one paragraph), starting at paragraph 3 and taking every third (3, 6, 9, ... 171 of 172); 15 claims drawn from those paragraphs

score_evidence.A: Clear arc: TL;DR, problem (L17), architecture (L29-39), loop, tools, hooks/middleware, interventions, steering, structured output, conversation, HITL, retries, limits, deployment, when-to-choose (L1002). Deductions: a mid-body horizontal rule plus a stray generator note at L484-486 ("참고: 요청하신 `LLMSteeringHandler` import 줄은 넣지 않았습니다. 정확한 경로를 담은 코드 근거가 확보되면 ..."), an orphaned fragment between sections; "### Sources" (L1041) sits as an H3 under the closing H2 section.
score_evidence.B: Mostly natural Korean in the 입니다 register with English API terms kept. Deductions: L486 is writer-to-requester meta talk; L518 "원래 예시는 마감일이 오늘 이후인지 `field_validator`로 검사합니다" talks about the input the reader never saw (rewrite: "공식 문서의 예는 마감일이 오늘 이후인지 `field_validator`로 검사합니다"); L140 "이 주입은 검증을 마친 입력에 제자리로 이루어지며" is an 'in place' calque (rewrite: "프레임워크는 검증을 마친 입력에 컨텍스트 객체를 직접 넣으며"); "Python과 TypeScript용 오픈소스 SDK" stated at L13, L21 and L27; mixed "이 글의 판단으로는"/"이 가이드의 판단으로는" (L99 vs L1000).
score_evidence.C: Concepts built in order and the running order-processing agent ties sections together; back-references ("앞서 본 훅의 도구 호출 제한", L322) are accurate. Deductions: repeated re-statements (L41 restates L29; soft-cap limits L836 and L1024; ConcurrencyException L873 and L1027; after_model_call Guide cap L390 and L478); L369 composes LLM steering into the interventions order before steering is introduced and without noting it is a plugin in Python.
score_evidence.D: Hard parts get worked examples with numbers: message-count formula (L93-97), hook Before/After order with audit/metrics (L209), the interventions composition table (L371), the token-budget walk-through (L840-845), per_turn table (L608). Minor padding: the trust-mode reasoning at L705 over-explains a corner case.
score_evidence.E: Tables where comparisons occur, ASCII diagrams for loop, layering and span hierarchy, code for every API. No remote images. Deduction: the interventions table at L374 has a wrong cell (LLM 스티어링 = Transform); the structured-output attempt table L577-582 shows wrong counts (see F).
score_evidence.F: All 15 sampled claims are supported, but two errors outside the sample, each at least -2: (1) L374 lists Transform as the LLM steering handler's decision, while steering handlers can only return Proceed/Guide/Confirm (steering page: "The wider intervention vocabulary (Deny, Transform) is excluded at the type level"), which the post itself says at L421; (2) L581-584 counts the text-ending response as failed attempt 2 and says the forced retry never runs, but the docs count only "a structured output tool call that fails validation, or a forced retry that doesn't return valid structured output", so the forced retry would run and be attempt 2. L486's meta note is an artifact leak; the import path it claims was unavailable is on the steering page (`from strands.vended_plugins.steering import LLMSteeringHandler`).
score_evidence.T1: Real flags and defaults throughout (limits dict, per_turn, retry_strategy, structured_output_prompt, HumanInTheLoop allowed_tools, idempotency_token, cancel_signal). Deductions: many snippets omit imports (HookProvider/HookRegistry, InterventionHandler/Deny/Proceed, HumanInTheLoop, DockerSandbox, make_shell, LLMSteeringHandler explicitly), so they cannot be pasted and run; refund/send_email/delete_file tools are never defined.
score_evidence.T2: Covers the source docs' main topics (agent loop, hooks, middleware, interventions, steering, structured output, conversation management, HITL, retries, lifecycle controls, sandbox, telemetry) in a sensible order; little unsupported padding. Deployment section leans on blog sources but labels its advice as the writer's.
score_evidence.T3: Explains internals and why: hooks wrap outside the middleware chain (L297-306), typed decisions vs last-write-wins (L322-324), fresh inner steering agent for statelessness (L459), cooperative cancellation and checkpoints, soft caps; system fit via OTEL span hierarchy, sandbox split, monolith/microservice/return-of-control, A2A, AG-UI; failure modes listed at L1022-1029. Design advice is marked as recommendation.

numbers_with_scope_and_unit.evidence: L956 token counts scoped to "항공편 예약 데모 에이전트를 한 번 실행했을 때"; L759 "4초에서 시작하는 지수 백오프"; L202 HookOrder values; version-scoped fixes "v1.25.0부터".
